description: OpenLLMetry's chromadb, qdrant and milvus instrumentors: add, query and delete on Chroma, Qdrant and Milvus Lite.
notes: OpenLLMetry's vector database instrumentors in envs/vector: opentelemetry-instrumentation-chromadb and -qdrant 0.63.1, -milvus 0.60.0 (0.63.1 cannot install, spike finding 3), on the harness tracer provider. The same add, query and delete on each database as genai/openlit-vector: Chroma in memory, Qdrant in :memory: local mode, Milvus Lite on a temp path (a directory Milvus Lite writes there) that is removed first. Qdrant's create_collection is not wrapped, so it writes no span; Milvus's is wrapped and writes one. None of these instrumentors writes gen_ai.operation.name, traceloop.span.kind or llm.request.type: no convention is detected, and the kind comes from the span-name table alone. Expected kinds per Q1 (a): chroma.query, qdrant.query_points and milvus.search are retriever; every write stays span.
